newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia 10-yr bond futures hit record high.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia 10-yr bond futures hit record high.

text.p: The Australian 10-year bond futures contract hit a record high of 93.640 in mid-afternoon trading on Thursday, overtaking the previous 93.630 peak set in early 1994.
The contract, which was first listed on the Sydney Futures Exchange in December 1984, closed on Wednesday at 93.520.
The market's bullish tone was in the wake of weaker than expected second quarter wages data, which fuelled already strong expectations of a monetary policy easing.
